title: RentGuard Renters Policy Cure Amount Calculation Sheet
content:
The cure amount on a RentGuard Renters Policy cancelled for nonpayment is worked out in this order, from the entries posted on the policy's premium account.

## 1. Unpaid charges

The unpaid charges are every installment billed, fee charged, payment returned, additional premium and refund posted on the premium account, less every payment received, fee waived, write-off and return premium posted on it other than the latest cancellation credit, rounded half-up to the cent.

The latest cancellation credit is the return premium entry for cancellation posted most recently on the account. It is the one return premium entry that is not taken off.

| Counted as a charge | Counted as a credit |
|---|---|
| every installment billed | every payment received |
| every fee charged | every fee waived |
| every payment returned | every write-off |
| every additional premium entry | every return premium entry other than the latest cancellation credit |
| every refund issued | |

## 2. Late charges of the current term

The late charges collected with the cure are every late charge of the current term. The current term's late charges are taken out of the unpaid charges and the late charges collected with the cure are put back first.

## 3. The cure amount

The cure amount is the unpaid charges, never below 0.00, rounded half-up to the cent. Once the late charges have been put back, any amount added to the cure is then added and any amount taken off the cure is taken off, and the total, never below 0.00, is rounded half-up to the cent once, on the final figure only.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical cancelled RentGuard policy shows installments billed of 240.00, fees charged of 25.00 (of which 10.00 are late charges of the current term), one payment returned of 20.00, payments received of 120.00 and a single return premium entry, the cancellation credit of 90.00.

1. Charges: 240.00, 25.00 and 20.00 total 285.00.
2. Credits other than the latest cancellation credit: 120.00.
3. Unpaid charges: 285.00 less 120.00, which is 165.00.
4. The current term's late charges of 10.00 are taken out, leaving 155.00, and the late charges collected with the cure, the same 10.00, are put back, giving 165.00.
5. Cure amount: 165.00.

A second hypothetical account whose credits other than the latest cancellation credit exceed its charges by 15.00 has unpaid charges that are a credit of 15.00; its cure amount is 0.00, never a negative figure.
